caption: The drawing depicts a lidded decorative glass vessel with a pedestal base, primarily colored in shades of bluish-green and gray with metallic gold accents. The vessel features a wide, faceted bowl with geometric panels, supported by a stem adorned with ornate, sculptural gold details that appear to resemble stylized leaves or scrolls. The round base flares out slightly and is shaded to indicate the reflective surface. The lid of the vessel is topped with a sculpted gold finial in the form of a head with stylized hair or headwear. Beneath the main perspective view, there is a side profile view of the vessel along with two circles of differing diameters, likely representing the plan view of the bowl and base, accompanied by a scale indicating "1/4 inch to inch." The background is a plain, light beige color, and there is a signature in the bottom left corner of the drawing.
title: Covered Compote
